artworks.label: Opal sea slug
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for jellylight. One dreamlike translucent marine nudibranch sea slug, gently curved opalescent glassy body with a ruffled clear fin-like mantle, two delicate rhinophores and a graceful cluster of fine lavender-pink cerata, tiny luminous cyan pinpoints suspended inside the body. Premium photoreal bioluminescent deep-sea fantasy, delicate glass-like wet tissue and subtle internal light, navy-reflected/cyan/lavender/pearl palette. No jellyfish, ctenophore, stingray, anemone, orb, text or background sea panel. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
